confirmed_symptom: Checkout API returns 500 when payment provider sends an empty optional reference.
hypothesis: Null handling regressed in payment response mapping.
expected_behavior: Empty optional provider reference is mapped to null without throwing while non-empty references remain unchanged.

rollback.mechanism: Revert the exact hotfix commit and redeploy the prior application artifact.
rollback.trigger: Error rate, latency, or payment failure rate worsens after deployment.
